chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'Did any of your forefathers fast in the month of Shaban?' He said, 'The best of my forefathers is the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), he fasted it.'

key_terms.شَعْبَان: Shaban, the eighth month of the Islamic lunar calendar

ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet Muhammad fast in the month of Shaban according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies the Prophet Muhammad as the 'best of the ancestors' who fasted in Shaban, thereby establishing the Prophet’s practice as the primary model for the Ahl al-Bayt. This highlights the continuity of devotional practices within the Imams, where the Prophet’s voluntary fasting serves as a precedent for the reverence shown to the month of Shaban before Ramadan.
